title: poa arctica var. grayana
intro: Poa arctica var. grayana, commonly known as Arctic blue grass, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. It is native to the Arctic regions of North America and has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits. The plant is said to have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including wound healing and antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of Arctic blue grass include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and lignans, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
